model.note: the Phase 16 recipe, carried over unchanged; no new tuning on any validation or hold-out set

arms.B0: C0 trained with the original weak-label mask
arms.C1: C0 trained with the candidate mask (same seed, split, initialisation as B0)
arms.M0: metadata-only logistic regression and boosted tree fitted on the same training studies (header features)
arms.S: C0 trained on the candidate mask with labels shuffled across training studies (paired with C1)
arms.N: untrained C0, seeds 9001-9010, forward pass only

phase16_holdout_pool.description: v0.1.0 manifest studies NOT in the 1,200 selection; never trained or validated on in Phases 14-15 (they appeared in the larger Phase 9-13 runs, so this is not independent data)

protected_sets.kaggle_test: excluded by the manifest and re-checked per run

evaluation_policy.weak_label_validation: descriptive only: the registered validation partitions scored with the manifest's own labels; never a basis for a claim
evaluation_policy.phase16_holdout: already inspected in Phases 16 and 16X; not independent confirmation; excluded from training/validation; may be reported descriptively only
evaluation_policy.independent_evidence: requires a human-adjudicated reference disjoint from the training pool, all validation partitions, the Phase 16 hold-out, the gold and test sets; if it does not exist, the result is reported with that limitation and no claim is made

forbidden: choice of arm, seed or epoch after seeing results
